scope: Bounded automatic scheduling runtime and feasibility-first search; no live API/database writes by this verification

boundedSearch.objectiveOrder: Unchanged; earliest valid candidates obtain a complete incumbent before the existing configured lexicographic optimization.
boundedSearch.cooperation: Event-loop yield before each fixture search and after each synchronous candidate batch; cancellation and deadline checked after yielding.

observedOriginalFailures.note: Before equivalent first-valid bucket and source-time lower-bound optimizations.

actualOfficialDataPureRuns.note: Exact frozen source including complete-incumbent and all-locked hard-objective guards.

coverage: Official API parser accepts 120000ms and rejects larger or invalid values.
Planner honors budgets above the old 15000ms clamp.
First-only candidate enumeration preserves earliest representatives; original 2/3 representative policies remain unchanged.
Date range, availability overrides, dependencies, existing entries and cancellation remain enforced.
Published and locked flags independently freeze schedules.
A full-count candidate cannot replace a validated incumbent before full-plan validation.
All-locked scopes still reject mandatory knockout rest-balance violations.

limitations: Pure runs use captured official API fixtures and resources with empty entries only in local memory. They do not replace production data sources.
New long-running official HTTP preview on an unpublished tournament is NOT TESTED by this agent; existing demos are published and the publication guard remains enforced.
Cooperative yields occur between synchronous candidate batches; observed event-loop gaps were at most 1862ms in these smokes, not a hard latency guarantee.
Completing one valid plan does not prove globally optimal preferences or feasibility for all possible resources.
Root owns final full monorepo checks, Docker deployment, frontend timeout integration and live browser acceptance.
